FN-A3JISSQ-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 290
Committee: Education Policy Sponsor: Representative Ed Oliver
Analyst: John Friedenreich Date: 04/09/2024
House Bill 290 as introduced could increase the obligations of local boards of education
beginning with the 2025-2026 school year by an undetermined amount to develop and
implement a cardiac emergency response plan pursuant to the provisions of this bill dependent
upon any costs related to the training of school personnel in first aid, CPR, and the use of an
automated external defibrillator (AED), if such training has not been completed.
Page 1
